historical_anchor.baseline: Essex, CV-18-equivalent (historical Wasp; branch provisional Oriskany naming unresolved) and San Jacinto conduct Marcus strikes 19-20 May and Wake strikes 23-24 May as combat work-up and FORAGER neutralization.

branch_execution.19_20May_Marcus: GO. New air groups receive real combat work-up; shore installations/air capability are suppressed enough that Marcus cannot materially interfere with the immediate Marianas approach.
branch_execution.21May: Weather/operational pause retained as a sanity anchor; no invented extra strike day.
branch_execution.23_24May_Wake: GO. Wake is hit and re-neutralized for FORAGER preparation. No landing attempt.
branch_execution.training_result: Target preassignment concept is judged less effective than hoped; tactical air-group direction remains preferred. This soft lesson improves June strike planning modestly without granting a blanket combat scalar.
branch_execution.Japanese_fleet_reaction: NONE. No high-value Japanese fleet target is present and branch ISR does not create a weapon-quality track against TG58.6 for the Mobile Fleet.

strategic_meaning: These raids are not an alternative to FORAGER; they are part of the approach-shaping and new-air-group integration process.
